page.overview:
Who is Vossler?

Vossler is a guest party member in Final Fantasy XII, who joins the party twice and is also present in the prologue. He is also fought as a boss.

When Vossler joins the party as a guest, his level is the average level of the two highest leveled party members +4. The formula for Vossler's stats remain the same between the first and second time he joins the party; if the average level of the top two characters is higher, his will be that much higher.

He comes equipped with Nightmare greatsword, Scale Armor or Chainmail armor, Sallet or Winged Helm headgear, and the Armguard or Gauntlets. There are two versions of the weapon; one for each instance he joins the party as a guest.

The first version of Nightmare has 26 Attack Power, 5 Evade, a Charge Time of 35, and a combo rate of 12. The second version is slightly more effective: 29 Attack Power and a combo rate of 14. In the Zodiac versions, the first version of Nightmare instead has 27 Attack Power and 10 Evade, while the second version is further buffed: 30 Attack Power, 10 Evade, and a Charge Time of 30.
